title: 3D racing-helmet hero
description: An original racing-style helmet built procedurally in Three.js — domed shell, chin bar, glossy fresnel-lit visor and brow vent — slowly auto-rotating and tilting toward the cursor over a soft gradient. Recreates the feel of a hero product showpiece using only generated geometry, no external 3D model.

source.name: original procedural model; feel inspired by landonorris.com hero (Off+Brand)

a11y: Honors prefers-reduced-motion: stops the auto-spin/parallax loop and renders a single static three-quarter view.
